discovery_notes_sha_basis: All 44 source-frame sheets reviewed by Codex; not human expert annotations.

conditions: Target GT includes Wrong tool; retain all co-occurring labels.
Target hand visibly selects, aligns or applies tool T0.
Context shows the same hand replace T0 with visibly distinct T1 and resume work on the same localized component; exact fastener identity can remain unknown.
GT tool names and context actions agree with visible object tracking; recovery phase strengthens a local relation but is not mandatory or causal proof.
rules.allowed_claim: During the GT-labelled interval T0 was selected/attempted; afterwards the operator switched to T1 and continued at the component.
prohibited_claims: T0 cannot fit that screw slot unless the slot and applicable reference are verified.
Every tool switch is a correction.
A model color guess independently proves a screwdriver subtype.
Every use of T0 on model A/B is an error.

conditions: Resolve the target hand, object, origin, destination and release within target frames.
For a wrong-location explanation, require an applicable documented or independently verified placement/orientation constraint.
A same-object relocation can describe subsequent behavior; do not call it a correction unless its normative basis is established.
rules.allowed_claim: The target hand placed/released the visible object at the observed location; GT labels this interval Spatial.
prohibited_claims: Anything outside the dark oval is Spatial.
A tool on the central mat is always Spatial.
Every transfer or temporary placement is erroneous.
A storage bin is correct because it is nearest or contains similar objects.

common_exclusions: Holding without using is not automatically Wrong tool or Handling.
Using fingers is not automatically Wrong tool.
Adjacent anomaly/normal segments of one continuous act are boundary probes, not independent matched controls.
Same verb/noun does not guarantee same object state or intent.
Schema-valid citations do not prove factual correctness.

validation_protocol.assessment: Apply frozen evidence conditions to 27 held-participant cases; report supported local sequence, visible fact only, or unknown, without a classifier accuracy claim.
validation_protocol.minimum_independent_replication_for_gene: Not established; no universal rule release from this pilot.
